summary: Redesign the Room Listing page (/rooms) to match the updated Figma design
description: The new layout introduces a card grid with larger imagery, an enhanced filter experience with amenity-based filtering, and visual indicators for loyalty point earnings. The redesign must be gated behind feature flag room-listing-v2 so the existing page remains available as a fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: New room cards display larger hero images (16:9) with gradient overlay showing room name and starting price
AC-2: Each card shows amenity icon row (max 5 icons) instead of text badges
AC-3: Amenities multi-select filter on FilterBar (ocean-view, pet-friendly, spa, etc.)
AC-4: Loyalty points badge Earn ~{points} points where points = pricePerNight * 10
AC-5: Sold out rooms show muted card with waitlist CTA instead of hiding
AC-6: Redesign behind feature flag room-listing-v2 using isFeatureEnabled()
AC-7: Existing analytics continue; add room_listing_amenity_filter_click, room_listing_loyalty_badge_hover, room_listing_waitlist_click
AC-8: E2E tests green for V1; new E2E for V2 behind flag
AC-9: Unit tests for RoomCardV2, amenity filter, loyalty math, feature flag toggle
AC-10: No CWV regression (LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms)
technicalNotes: Create components/RoomCardV2.tsx — do not modify RoomCard
Extend filterRooms() in lib/rooms.ts for amenities
